thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated node provisioning failures in us-west-2 (k8s events show image pull errors). Summary: ~40% of new node boots failing with imagePullBackOff for nvidia/cuda images and base images hosted on Docker Hub. Tag: nvidia/cuda:12.1.1-cudnn
oncall-engr: Pager received. I'm on it, taking the incident. Assigning severity: Sev 2 unless customers report major outages.
andrea: seeing the same from autoscaler logs: `Failed to pull image \"docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1.1-cudnn\": received status code 429` — rate limit / auth? 100s/min of 429 in the last 10m
matt: which registry host? logs show `registry-1.docker.io` and also `auth.docker.io` 403/429 spikes. Some nodes show TLS handshakes timing out.
ops_sre: Confirmed: k8s events on new nodes:
```
Failed to pull image "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1.1-cudnn": rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to pull and unpack image "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1.1-cudnn": failed to resolve reference "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:12.1.1-cudnn": received unexpected status code 429
```
eng-infra-lead: This looks like Docker Hub rate-limiting (we've hit anonymous pull limits on the autoscaler pool) + NVIDIA images pulling from docker.io. We have some cached nodes that passed, so existing workloads are fine, but scale-ups are impacted. Customer-facing features should be fine for steady-state traffic.
pm-ryan: Any customers escalated yet? Cust-succ, please flag if any paying customers report degraded UX.
cust-succ: No inbound tickets yet, we're proactively checking top enterprise accounts. We'll update if anything pops.
andrea: mitigation plan options:
- short term: switch node bootstrap to use GHCR or a private mirror for the CUDA base images (we have prebuilt ghcr.redwood-inference/cuda:12.1 images)
- mid term: pre-pull images on scale-up by running a sidecar init or use a custom node image with cache
- fallback: temporarily throttle autoscaler to avoid repeated pulls and keep existing capacity
matt: I can push a patch to the cluster-autoscaler launch script to set `--max-node-provisioning=1` to reduce blast radius and force reuse of warm nodes.
oncall-engr: Good. I'll also open support tickets with Docker Hub and NVIDIA. @andrea can you validate the GHCR image is compatible (same digest / libs)?
andrea: Doing a quick diff. GHCR image manifest matches runtime libs, but the tag names differ. I can update the node bootstrap script to reference `ghcr.io/redwood/cuda:12.1-cudnn` and we should be good.
eng-infra-lead: Steps I'm going to take now:
1) Patch node bootstrap in kube cloud-controller to use GHCR. Command (testing in staging):
```
kubectl patch daemonset node-bootstrap -n kube-system --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/image","value":"ghcr.io/redwood/cuda:12.1-cudnn"}]'
```
2) Add a background job to pre-pull on new nodes:
```
kubectl apply -f prepull-job.yaml -n kube-system
```
3) Temporarily reduce cluster-autoscaler aggressiveness:
```
kubectl scale deployment cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system --replicas=1
# and edit config map to lower max-node-provisioning
```
matt: I'll also add a quick admission webhook to allow pulling from GHCR/registry mirrors — some node policies block non-docker.io images by default.
ops_sre: Warning: changing image source will require careful rollout. We should target a single ASG/zone first (canary) and monitor.
pm-ryan: Please include impact statement to customers if degradation expected. Draft: "We are currently experiencing image registry rate limits that are delaying provisioning of additional capacity in us-west-2. Existing workloads are unaffected; scale-ups may be delayed up to ~10-15 minutes. We're actively rolling out a mirror-based fallback."
oncall-engr: Starting the canary rollout to a single autoscaler group now. Will post updates every 5m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
(andrea): canary looks good — instance launched and kubelet booted with GHCR image. No imagePullBackOff in events after change.
incident-bot: UPDATE: Canary success. Metrics: 0 image pull failures in canary group for last 6m. Proceeding to broader rollout.
matt: rolling changes to remaining node bootstrap configs. Pushing patch to infra repo and kicking a rolling restart of kube-system bootstrap pods.
ops_sre: Also enabling a temporary 24h mirror cache on our internal registry: `registry.internal.redwood/artifacts/nvidia/cuda:12.1.1`. Pre-pulling onto warm nodes now:
```
for node in $(kubectl get nodes -l warm=true -o name); do ssh $node "docker pull registry.internal.redwood/artifacts/nvidia/cuda:12.1.1" & done
```
cust-succ: Notified top 10 enterprise customers with the drafted impact statement. No active incidents reported; some questions about RTO which we've answered.
oncall-engr: We've reduced autoscaler provisioning rate, applied GHCR fallback, and pre-pulled onto warm nodes. Error rate on new node events dropped from ~40% to <2%.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity downgraded to Sev 3. Monitoring for 2h. :white_check_mark:
eng-infra-lead: Follow-ups/Action items assigned:
- (andrea) Validate all CUDA variants we use have GHCR mirrors and update infra images (ETA 2h)
- (matt) Add mirror failsafe to bootstrap with retry/backoff to avoid thrashing autoscaler (ETA 4h)
- (ops_sre) Postmortem + timeline + customer impact (ETA EOD)
- (pm-ryan) Update status page with brief note once incident fully resolved (ETA after 2h observation)
pm-ryan: Agree. Also recommend we add a cached node image template (baked AMI) to reduce runtime pulls long-term.
cust-succ: Customers on call appreciated proactive notice. No immediate escalations.
oncall-engr: Filing support tickets: Docker Hub ticket #DH-84213 (rate limiting incidents), NVIDIA ticket #NV-5591 (mirror health). Attaching logs.
incident-bot: RESOLUTION: After 2h stability window, image pull failures returned to baseline. Incident closed. Postmortem scheduled.
andrea: quick note for the postmortem: root cause appears to be a sudden spike in anonymous pulls from our autoscaler (multiple scale events) combined with Docker Hub's stricter enforcement this week. We relied on docker.io defaults; need hardened mirror/resilience strategy.
ops_sre: tagging postmortem severity: P1 (impact to provisioning), lessons: use private registry for large vendor images, bake images more aggressively, throttle autoscaler on large bursts.
matt: leaving this thread — oncall handoff to night shift @oncall-night. Handed off with notes in PagerDuty runbook.
oncall-engr: leaving the incident. Thanks all. :pray:
